items.title: What Spain’s response to Ukraine reveals about Its approach to immigration
items.summary: Spain has repeatedly used administrative mechanisms to integrate large foreign populations into legal residence, employment and public systems. Its response to Ukrainians made that particularly visible because it happened rapidly and at significant scale. The 2026 regularization showed that the broader policy direction was not confined to Ukrainians
